BUYERS BEWARE - Jennifer sold us a used and damaged floor model. This was not agreed on or in the contract.
There are violations according to the DTPA and many more.codes i can state they are in violation of.
We have been trying to speak to the owner Dan and still blocked from talking to him . If this is not made right well go legal . This place used to be amazing and now its.gone downhill.
I have a whole time.line of specifics if you want to mess with me . I can go all day.

JENNIFER the store manager lied but I was told from another location that Rob is the store manager so idk whose telling the truth now  .   . Jennifer said in exact words we could get the hot tub delivered when we wanted or possibly same day . I made a $200.deposit and signed on the $200.  We came back Friday to make the transaction of 5400 in which the price was wrong !!! She wanted my signature. I had questions and wanted everything in writing . She said it was in the manufacturing manuel but it was not . Therefore I never gave her a signature.  Texas is a community property state in which my husband and i sign on everything together. She said we would be getting a hot tub straight from.the factory  brand new !!!!!
I found out the delivery guys were not able to deliver same day or on the weekend as Jennifer stated so I called the store to lecture her. She denied and would not take accountability for her actions.  I asked to speak with the owner and she kept blocking me from talking to him  . I then wrote a bad review and Rob called me right away  justifying Jennifer's actions saying  she had a bad day and to give her another chance. I forgive but do not forget .  Rob apologized for her actions and said he would talk to her .

Today the delivery guys were late but the sweetest. We gave them water everthing. The spa had water in it so we had assumed it was from the ware house to check for leaks. The delivery guys told us it was damaged and had a missing part.

went up to bonnie and clydes to get the part but jennifer tried to say it was normal when it was not ! Its even in the manufacture manuel ! Then saw the floor model was gone so my husband asked if she sold us the floor model and she said yes like she was so proud. reviews.text:
Right up front I debated taking off one or two stars for installation.

The bad first.  A&A Installation should not be used.  They don't stand behind their work and customer service is non-existent.  The list is long but the worst example was a slow leak I had all summer which turned into a large leak a couple weeks ago.  The culprit turned out to be a PVC coupling that WASN'T EVEN GLUED in place.

Again, DO NOT USE A&A INSTALLATION.

Now the good.  After giving up on the initial installer I called the store and spoke with Dan.  Owner? GM? Not exactly sure but he made some calls and was able to get Campbell Pool Installation out to take care of things.  They had everything taken apart, dug up, fixed, filled in, wiped down, lubed up, and running fine in a little over an hour.  So a big thank you to Dan and Campbell Pool Installation.  Also of note is the in-store support has always been very good with knowledgeable employees able to help and answer questions; Chandler in particular who was our salesman.
reviews.author: Brian Blatz
